Features

Every asset. Every return. One place.

Stocks on two continents, mutual fund SIPs, property, money lent to family and friends, and the monthly budget — Finance Tracker covers all of it.

Net worth dashboardUS & Indian stocksMutual funds & SIPsReal estateInterest investmentsOther investmentsFIRE calculatorMonthly expensesExcel import, export & backup
01

Net worth dashboard

Every asset you own rolled up into one number, with allocation by asset class and account holder.

  • Consolidated view across stocks, funds, property, loans, cash and other investments
  • Asset allocation breakdown and charts
  • Track holdings for each family member or demat account separately
02

US & Indian stocks

Portfolios for NYSE/NASDAQ and NSE with live quotes, realised and unrealised gains.

  • Buy and sell transactions with fees and dates
  • Live market prices and day change
  • USD holdings converted at the current USD/INR rate
  • Cash balance per account and a market news feed
03

Mutual funds & SIPs

Track lump sums, SIPs and redemptions with XIRR returns that account for every cash flow.

  • Holdings and transaction history per fund
  • Active and future SIP schedules
  • XIRR, absolute return and current value per fund
  • Bulk import from Excel
04

Real estate

Record land, flats and houses — including jointly owned property — with estimated appreciation and sales.

  • Purchase price, date and your ownership share
  • Track partners in jointly owned property
  • Estimated current value from yearly appreciation
  • Record sales and see the realised gain
05

Interest investments

Money you have lent out at interest — how much, to whom, and what has come back.

  • Borrower, amount and date given for each loan
  • Log every return received
  • Outstanding amount at a glance
06

Other investments

Fixed deposits, gold, PPF, bonds or anything else you want counted in your net worth.

  • Amount, date, currency and interest rate
  • Notes for maturity dates or scheme details
  • Included in the consolidated dashboard
07

FIRE calculator

See how close you are to financial independence based on what you have already saved.

  • Target corpus from your expenses and withdrawal rate
  • Progress based on your real portfolio value
  • Adjust inflation and return assumptions
08

Monthly expenses

Log monthly spending and obligations, then review month-by-month summaries.

  • Monthly expenses and recurring obligations
  • Monthly expense summary report
  • Import past months from Excel
09

Excel import, export & backup

Bring your existing spreadsheets in, export everything out, and keep full backups.

  • Import stocks, mutual funds, property and expenses from Excel
  • Export your whole portfolio to a formatted workbook
  • One-click JSON backup and restore
